properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] VMs for DNS: Guest Configuration Extension Must Be Installed
properties.description: Audits virtual machines that do not have the Azure Guest Configuration extension installed. FedRAMP High requires security configuration management (CM-6). The Guest Configuration extension enables continuous OS-level compliance assessment against DISA STIG and CIS benchmarks, detecting configuration drift and reporting compliance status to Azure Policy.

metadata.description: Audit: Report non-compliance for VMs without Guest Configuration extension. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
